title: In multiple locations, there is a possible permission bypass due to a confused deputy. (CVE-2026-58885)
description: CVE-2026-58885 is a vulnerability involving a possible permission bypass caused by a confused deputy problem in multiple locations. This flaw allows local escalation of privilege without requiring additional execution privileges or user interaction. The vulnerability has a high severity score of 8.4 and affects confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
